In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reference building approach is a useful tool for energy performance legislation.
the reference building approach is a useful tool in the design process of nZEBs, if it is supported by dynamic simulation.

, when dynamic simulation is carried out, the reference building approach can provide a useful and reliable tool for the design and assessment of nZEBs, provided that the notional reference buildings are properly defined and that dynamic simulation is used in the right way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reference building approach, when applied with a proper definition of its parameters, can be a valid tool to support the design of buildings with high energy performance.
the notional reference approach can be applied in the energy performance regulations, but the reference parameters must be more detailed, especially when dynamic simulations are performed.
, when dynamic simulation is used, the notional reference buildings should be defined with the same level of detail of the building under design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the future, the notional reference buildings could be more detailed and more representative of the real building stock.
the use of dynamic simulation in the notional approach could be an effective way to reduce the gap between the energy performance of the building and the energy performance of its reference building.

a more precise definition of the reference building is needed, in particular for the building envelope and for the HVAC system, to avoid that a nZEB can comply with the energy requirements only in the design phase.
